announcements.title: 官方宣布将重置 · 等待完成确认
announcements.scope: Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 的所有付费用户
announcements.text: o yes… we’re back in action and we’ll reset usage limits for all paid users across codex and ChatGPT work sorry about the brief disruption! (and yes we have a special spare codex when things are down to help us out)
announcements.summary: Tibo 表示服务已恢复，将为 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 的所有付费用户重置额度；本条尚未确认重置完成，请以个人账户为准。

announcements.title: Tibo 发布重置卡公告
announcements.text: GPT-6 Sol and Luna are out. Not only are they a very significant improvement across the board, but also in writing and general "you know when you try it" quality. We are also permanently reducing the API price by 50% making both of them viable for a ton of new usecases and making your usage go further too, even on the subscriptions. And one more thing. We are loading a banked reset into all accounts of our Plus, Pro and Business users. Let's go! https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-6-sol-and-luna/
announcements.summary: 检测到 Tibo 发布与 banked reset 或重置卡相关的公开信号。

announcements.title: 全量重置已完成
announcements.summary: 重置信号已经传播完成，所有用户可检查自己的额度状态。

announcements.title: 所有用户额度重置
announcements.text: All reset for everyone. Enjoy the week with Astra.
announcements.summary: Tibo 宣布所有用户完成重置，并邀请大家使用 Astra。

announcements.title: Plus / Pro / Business 获得重置卡
announcements.text: We will do the full banked reset today too for all Plus, Pro and Business users. Lands end of day.
announcements.summary: Astra 提前上线，符合条件的付费用户可获得一张可自行使用的重置卡。

announcements.title: Astra 等待用户每日补发一张卡
announcements.text: We will give one banked reset for every day you don't have access to Astra on your paid ChatGPT plan, starting today.
announcements.summary: 付费用户在尚未获得 Astra 期间，每等待一天可得到一张重置卡。

announcements.title: 庆祝 2500 万活跃用户
announcements.text: We hit 25M active users and to celebrate we have now reset usage for all paid subscriptions for ChatGPT Work and Codex.
announcements.summary: Codex 与 ChatGPT Work 达到 2500 万活跃用户，所有付费订阅获得额度重置。
